rubric.notes: The same face, broken nose, cropped hair, body mass, charcoal gi and wraps remain readable across all fourteen rows; proxy outliers are foreshortened or collapsed poses.
Forward and backward walks alternate support, attacks show load-contact-recovery, and jump, fall, knockout and victory sequences read in order.
Every pose keeps a clear side-view silhouette, plausible connected anatomy and a readable center of mass without detached effects.
Grounded states hold the shared foot baseline, jump leaves and returns to it, and collapsed states settle cleanly on the floor line.
Checker, black, gray, white and alpha-mask panels preserve the dark outline, wraps, toes and interior gaps without visible gray fringe.
All seventy-nine frames are present in the workbench and every state has deterministic playback evidence with stable scale and timing.
